newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice closes down but up from day's lows.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice closes down but up from day's lows.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed down but well above session lows as demand during the waning 20 minutes of trading contributed buoyancy, traders said.
"There was the Costa Rican tender today and there's not a lot of supply in the market. What's available is in strong hands," a trader said.
Traders also said roughly one half of the day's volume was traded during the final 20 minutes of activity.
Rice futures volume was estimated by the CBOT at 400 contracts, below the 989 traded Monday.
Rice futures closed three to five cents lower, with May down three at $11.71 per cwt.
